description: Every candidate must beat deterministic random side under the same opportunity and fill model grid.
Flipping bid/ask interpretation must degrade or invert edge, not improve it by accident.
Evaluate Zerodha statutory/brokerage charges at base, 1.5x and 2x.
Stress L1 queue crowding and top-five churn with fill haircut and adverse-selection penalty multipliers.
Unfilled passive quotes must earn zero spread capture and may still incur opportunity/latency risk in sensitivity checks.
Best candidate must exceed minimum opportunity, symbol and fill-equivalent breadth before any promotion discussion.
Use Zerodha top-five depth rows 1-5; levels 2-5 materiality is mandatory.
No L1-only strategy, feature, filter or candidate variant can survive.
